title: ÆTHER album Kaattu Thee, song 4: Dance v2 (simple kuthu, instrumental, one take)
story: Rudra's friends drag him into the street wedding procession and the whole lane turns into a dance floor.

brief.notes: Jithesh 13:46-13:48 on dance v1 (Arabic-kuthu fusion, many sections): 'total disaster', 'everything is wrong'. v1 overloaded the prompt (fusion scale + seven sections). v2 uses the same simple shape that worked for the locked intro and the fight theme: one clear hook, a quiet start on one instrument, a build, a short silence, one big drop, the hook bigger, a clean ending. Plain Tamil kuthu, no Arabic fusion. One take.

prompt: A modern Tamil film dance number, instrumental, new-generation Kollywood kuthu style. Built around ONE simple, bouncy, catchy hook melody in a minor key with an Indian flavour, played on a bright reedy nadaswaram-like synth lead, then doubled by a whistle and punchy brass. The melody is simple, repeats often and is easy to hum after one listen. Clean, punchy, musical production with space, not noisy: a swinging dappankuthu bounce at 106 BPM on loud thappu and parai drums with a tight kick, claps and deep 808 bass, a gang 'hey' shout only on the big beats. Starts with the thappu drums and the melody alone, builds with a riser, a short silence, then a big drop around 16 seconds where the drums, bass and brass carry the full melody. A second, bigger statement of the melody, ends cleanly on one hard full-band hit.
